text_block_list.text:
"I want to declare that I'll take 1st in everything
up on the stage."

To grant Smart Falcon's wish,
we announced a 'major news' mini-live,
and a huge crowd gathered from both on and off campus.

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was an awesome concert!
I can't wait for the big announcement coming up next!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
The announcement from the spotlight Umamusume, Smart Falcon...
We can't afford to miss it!
We're going to publish the scoop first!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone, thank you so much
for coming out for Falco today☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And now, just as announced,
Falco will make her announ-cement...?
Huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehe☆
Falco has an announcement to make~!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh~?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, curious~?
If you want to know, give me a round of applause☆
(Clap clap clap clap clap!!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's pretty much everyone! Excellent!
Well then... I will now announce it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Falco hereby declares!
She's gonna take 1st place in every single target race she names!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Oooooh...?
The spectators were bewildered at first. However, with every race name she called out, their bewilderment turned into a stirring buzz—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—And finally, the Tokyo Daishoten!
Falco will be center stage for all of them☆

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan
text_block_list.text: A-Amazing~! I gotta post about this on Umatter—wait, she's already trending!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
A victory declaration already...!
Looks like this year's Smart Falcon is built different from last year...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Hello?
I've got a breaking scoop, so get ready to run it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
The headline reads...
'The Birth of the Absolute Dirt Monarch!?
A Bold Declaration of Victory from Smart Falcon!'

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Ooh~, it's number 1 on trending.
It really blew up!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. With this, I'm sure everyone will be
wondering whether Falco can really win.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... No turning back now.
Guess it's "Victory is the only option! ☆" time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Falcon-san.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Flash-san!
Heading to lunch now?

Eishin Flash. Smart Falcon's roommate,
and an Umamusume currently making waves on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No.
I just happened to spot Falcon-san...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Huh~? Flash-san, you really like Falco a lot, don't you?☆"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Isn't it a bit of a leap to assume that simply striking up a conversation immediately equates to romantic interest, completely disregarding context?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa~
You're acting way too cold all of a sudden!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, that declaration from earlier seems to be causing quite a stir.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, were you watching me by any chance?
Oh my~, you really are a Falco fan after all☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No. I was simply curious to hear what you had to say,
given that you're usually so spontaneous, Falcon-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“Still, having your schedule so neatly laid out
not just for the near future, but all the way through year-end...
You really managed to plan it all out, didn't you?”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I-It doesn't really feel like a compliment, but... "Thank you" is the right answer, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However... if you're too calculated,
I feel like that wouldn't be very Falcon-san either.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...No, please forget it.
By all means, do make sure to stick to that wonderful schedule of yours.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Flash-san,
weren't you kind of contradicting yourself?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
She's always so meticulous when she speaks, though.
I wonder what that was about?
choice_data_list: Why don't you ask when you're back at the dorm?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, let me see...—Ah!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, about the schedule!
Right after the concert,
someone handed me their business card asking for an interview.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A bunch of others are probably coming too,
so let's sort out the schedule right now!
I was curious about what Eishin Flash had said, but I ended up getting swamped handling the press interviews that came pouring in one after another.
